title: Object Storage: outage credit handling
content:
Object Storage outage credit is handled on request. Post one storage service concession against an original invoice. The agent records an immediately visible signed receivable reduction with the source invoice and approved assessment; the posted receipt confirms the financial credit.

## Invocation

post_storage_service_concession_cfd2170f. This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

- storage_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the selected storage evidence or assessment copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage credit input.
- storage_holding_id: Id class — Identifier of the storage contract copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage credit input.
- source_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the original invoice or completed payment copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage credit input.
- related_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the linked incident, assessment or concession copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage credit input.
- request_id: Id class — Identifier of the customer claim or refund authorization copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage credit input.
- customer_id: Id class — Identifier of the enterprise customer profile copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage credit input.
- amount: Fixed-format class — Unit USD; format USD to two decimals. Signed financial receivable delta as a decimal number, rounded half-up before submission and stored to two decimal places; empty is not allowed. This is the outage credit input.

## Successful return

For outage credit, a string reading Recorded with the storage business record identifier and the USD amount; Recorded confirms that the stated action completed successfully.
